title: Inverted Diver and Orca
description: A surreal landscape shows a woman in a black wetsuit floating upside down above a lake's surface with her reflection below, while an orca whale swims directly beneath her. A wooden rowboat floats among yellow lily pads as sunbeams pierce the water from a bright sun, with mountains, grass, and multiple celestial bodies in the sky.
prompt: Surreal landscape with a female diver in black wetsuit floating upside down above a clear blue lake, her body mirrored below the surface alongside a large orca whale swimming beneath her. A wooden rowboat rests on the water among yellow lily pads. Sunbeams shine down from a bright sun in a sky containing multiple suns, a crescent moon and planets. Grassy shores and distant blue mountains complete the dreamlike scene.
